services.desc: Experience the music and vision of David Bowie in a sweeping, full-dome journey inside Shafran Planetarium! Throughout his career, Bowie was known for his ability to speak about global themes and express himself through characters. Art, painting, fashion, and performance were some of the languages he used to communicate his ideas and set trends. In a timeless way, he captivated young audiences of every generation.
